model_lock.constitutive_gain: kappa_F is explicit and uncalibrated in absolute engineering units
model_lock.output_interpretation: all force magnitudes are per declared native normalization and scale linearly with kappa_F

scaling_laws.general: F is linear in total mass M, spin rate omega, and constitutive gain kappa_F
scaling_laws.fixed_omega_radius: independent of R for a uniform zero-thickness rim
scaling_laws.fixed_angular_momentum: F proportional to L/R^2 because L=M R^2 omega
scaling_laws.spin_reversal: omega -> -omega reverses every force vector and preserves the geometric ellipse

validation.torque_identity: r cross dF = 0 for every rim element because dF is parallel to u
